column1: # loans.tsv: English words used in Odia, with the attested Odia spelling.
# Generated by tools/build-data/build_loans.py; do not edit by hand (edit english.tsv).
# Sources: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary (BSD-2-Clause) for English words and sounds;
# SCOWL size-35 word list (permissive / public domain) for common English words;
# IndicCorp v2 Odia (CC0) word counts for attestation; Praharaj origin marks
# (public domain) to drop native look-alikes. Licence of this file: MIT.
# Found automatically: not reviewed by a native speaker.
# Persian, Arabic, Hindi, Turkish and Portuguese loans: Praharaj headwords with that
# origin mark and >= 500 IndicCorp occurrences, keyed by the single-word English
# meanings of the first sense (public domain; the 1930s sense).
# english<TAB>odia<TAB>language (en fa ar hi tr pt)<TAB>source<TAB>indiccorp_count
